name: What should I do immediately if I suspect a main water line break?

mainEntity.name: What should I do immediately if I suspect a main water line break?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you suspect a main water line break, the first step is to shut off your main water supply to prevent further water damage to your property. Locate your main shut-off valve, typically near your water meter or where the main line enters your home, and turn it clockwise until the water stops. Once the water is off, contact CG Plumbing Solutions immediately to schedule an emergency repair. This preparation helps minimize property damage and water loss.
acceptedAnswer.description: If you suspect a main water line break, immediately shut off your main water supply, then contact a professional plumber like CG Plumbing Solutions for emergency repair.
